# hyperfluid_group_role (Resource)

Binds a role's permission bundle to a group, organization-wide or narrowed by `scope_path`. Every argument forces a new binding. Requires `grant:create`, `grant:read` and `grant:delete`.

`resource_type` cannot be read back from the API: it is kept as configured, and is null after import.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hyperfluid_role" "editor_analytics" {
  name = "analytics-editor"
}

resource "hyperfluid_group_role" "data_eng_editor" {
  group_id   = hyperfluid_group.data_eng.id
  role_id    = hyperfluid_role.editor_analytics.id
  scope_path = "analytics"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Id of the group (`hyperfluid_group.id`).
- `role_id` (String) Id of a role of the organization (`hyperfluid_role.id`, or the `hyperfluid_role` data source for a system role such as `viewer`).

### Optional

- `resource_type` (String) Resource family of the bound resource, e.g. `secret`: only the role's permissions of that family apply. Requires an exact `scope_path`.
- `resource_uuid` (String) Id of the one resource `scope_path` names exactly. The binding then survives a rename of the resource and is removed with it. Requires an exact `scope_path`.
- `scope_path` (String) Path in the organization's resource tree the binding applies to: exact, an ancestor folder (covers what is beneath it), or a `*`-suffixed wildcard at a path boundary (`prod/*`). Omit for an organization-wide binding.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<group_id>/<role_id>[/<scope_path>]`, the import id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import id is "<group_id>/<role_id>" for an organization-wide binding, or
# "<group_id>/<role_id>/<scope_path>" (the scope path may contain slashes).
# resource_type cannot be read back and stays null after import.
terraform import hyperfluid_group_role.data_eng_editor 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111/analytics
```
